title: The caller says do not call me again
why: An opt-out has to win over everything else, including a half-finished screening. If it does not, the system keeps calling somebody who told it to stop.
testerScript: Confirm identity. Let the agent begin. Then interrupt: “Please don't call me about this again.” If it keeps going, say it once more, firmly.

assertions.label: the opt-out is recorded in the structured result
the opt-out wins over every other outcome
does not argue or keep screening
